question: Which product surface should own stale Discord thread session cleanup: preview/apply cleanup, a guarded agent/operator delete or GC tool, automatic plugin-owned retention, or no automatic cleanup for now?
rationale: The source path is clear, but removing rows is destructive session lifecycle policy across Discord reachability, transcript retention, config shape, and agent/operator permissions.

options.title: Preview/apply cleanup surface
options.body: Build reusable plugin-owned reachability and revalidation logic that can power a Dashboard or CLI preview before deleting stale rows.

options.title: Guarded agent/operator tool
options.body: Expose a permissioned delete or GC path to agents/operators, with explicit scope and transcript-retention rules.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Leave existing reset-and-preserve behavior in place until maintainers choose a broader session lifecycle policy.

recommendation.title: Preview/apply cleanup surface
recommendation.body: Build reusable plugin-owned reachability and revalidation logic that can power a Dashboard or CLI preview before deleting stale rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The core decision hinges on durable session maintenance policy and destructive cleanup semantics, where recent history points most strongly to this owner path.
